source: Google Earth web historical imagery: aerials of 6 Jun 2024 (anchor) and 22 Apr 2023, straight-down captures at 0.132 m a pixel. Each date's painted line traced along 1440 rays; 2023 lined up on 2024 by the line itself (shift -1.08, +2.21 m, rms 0.34 m) and the median taken. Goals: 50 m arc then the goal square (south goal on both dates, 0.25 m apart; north goal 2023 only).

error_m.placement: Checked against the model on main in a match top-down render: traced fence vs the model's fence edge median -0.24 m; on the open side (east, north, south) within +0.6 m; on the grandstand side the model's sign rail sits 1.1-1.9 m inside the real fence (the concourse wall), like GMHBA's sign ring.

frame: Google Earth's georeference of the 6 Jun 2024 aerial, in model metres (x east, z south) about tools/grounds/ge/grounds.json's Riverway origin.
fence_how: the thin dark line of the fence (its shadow) 1.5-15 m outward of the painted line in the same 2024 aerial (fence_dark.py): the grass carries on past Riverway's fence, so the grass edge can't be used; points off a robust smooth fit are fence_seen false.
